evidence: The self-limiting mechanism on which ALD is based on implies the deposition of one monolayer of HfO2 during each reaction cycle. Because the theoretical molecular density of HfO2 is 2.77 × 1022 Hf/cm3, the maximum coverage per ALD cycle may be simply calculated as the molecular density to the 2/3 power, equal to 9.15 × 1014 Hf/cm2. However, in a typical ALD process only partial monolayers are deposited per cycle, caused by a lack of reactive surface sites and/or steric hindrance of the precursor molecules adsorbed on the surface.
